# AWS SDK license source

The credential-provider-http, credential-provider-login and nested-clients npm distributions omit their Apache-2.0 license file. Their package metadata points to aws/aws-sdk-js-v3 and declares Apache-2.0. LICENSE is the unmodified repository license retrieved from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aws/aws-sdk-js-v3/main/LICENSE on 2026-11-03. The notice generator uses this local copy so it needs no network request.
